# Eigen 3.4.0

Vendored public `Eigen/` headers from the official Eigen 3.4.0 release:
https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen/-/archive/3.4.0/eigen-3.4.0.tar.gz

Archive SHA-256: `8586084f71f9bde545ee7fa6d00288b264a2b7ac3607b974e54d13e7162c1c72`.
Original license files are included. Eigen headers are predominantly MPL-2.0;
individual files retain their upstream notices. No network download is required
at configure/build time. Only project-owned files are formatted or modified.
